title: Binance Fully Lifts Withdrawal Suspension a Month After $6.3 Billion Hack
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Binance Fully Lifts Withdrawal Suspension a Month After $6.3 Billion Hack

Binance said its withdrawal recovery work is complete and the suspension tied to the Oct. 29 hack has been fully lifted, as researchers track North Korean launderers moving the stolen funds.

This post Binance Fully Lifts Withdrawal Suspension a Month After $6.3 Billion Hack first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: Russia’s VTB Opens Bitcoin Trading as Central Bank Finalizes Crypto Test
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Russia’s VTB Opens Bitcoin Trading as Central Bank Finalizes Crypto Test

VTB began letting qualified investors trade bitcoin in its app on Friday, a day after the Bank of Russia approved the knowledge test every crypto buyer must pass. SPB Exchange plans to open spot trading Dec. 1.

This post Russia’s VTB Opens Bitcoin Trading as Central Bank Finalizes Crypto Test first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: Spain Lets Anti-Money Laundering Unit Freeze Crypto Accounts Without a Judge
summary:

Spain Lets Anti-Money Laundering Unit Freeze Crypto Accounts Without a Judge

A royal decree lets Sepblac, Spain's financial intelligence unit, freeze crypto, bank and payment accounts for up to five business days without a court order.
